snippet.title: Crisol: Theater of Idols Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
On February 10th, blood is your weapon. Wishlist Crisol: Theater of Idols today on Steam, PlayStation, and Xbox. Play the demo on Steam.
https://www.blumhouse.com/games/crisol-theater-of-idols

Crisol: Theater of Idols is a first-person horror/action game set in Hispania, a twisted version of Spain. Play as Gabriel, a soldier who uses blood as both weapon and lifeline. Explore the cursed island of Tormentosa, uncover dark secrets, and battle horrifying enemies. Will you survive? Crisol is developed by Vermila Studios and published by Blumhouse Games. 

For more information, visit https://blumhouse.com/games/crisol-theater-of-idols and follow along: 
https://www.instagram.com/blumhousegames/

https://www.tiktok.com/@blumhousegames
